text:
Anita: quick follow-up from the pinning RFC — i'm proposing a small schema tweak: add 'grace_window_ms' + 'telemetry_tags' and split pin semantics into pin_intent vs pin_affinity. thoughts?
Ryan: +1 on telemetry_tags but worried about cardinality explosion if teams add freeform strings. maybe limit to enums or a small allowlist per tenant.
Liam: agree. for pin_intent i'd prefer explicit enum: [hard, soft, staging, canary]. keeps client logic simple.
Sara: how do clients learn about grace_window_ms? do we surface it in the rollout metadata so SDKs can automatically fall back after window expires?
Matt: ops note — any schema change needs a migration/backfill for existing pins. plan should be idempotent and include validation checks so we don't clobber live leases.
infra-bot: created INF-214: pin-schema-migration (https://phabricator.redwood/INF-214) :white_check_mark:
Anita: my thought: split fields into public vs internal. public: pin_hint, pin_intent, grace_window_ms, telemetry_tags, fallback_order; internal: lease_token, last_renewed_ms, internal_provenance. clients only see public fields.
Ryan: also add model_fingerprint (sha256 prefix) to detect accidental incompatible model variants. fallback logic can prefer same fingerprint.
Liam: add model_variant_id in pin reference and allow fallback_order as an array of variant ids. example: primary -> [variant-v2-q4, variant-v2-fp16].
Sara: quick schema sketch:
```
{
  "pin_hint": "release-2026-03",
  "pin_intent": "soft",
  "grace_window_ms": 300000,
  "telemetry_tags": ["qa-run", "cohort:alpha"],
  "model_variant_id": "variant-v2-q4",
  "fallback_order": ["variant-v2-q4","variant-v2-fp16"],
  "model_fingerprint": "sha256:9f2a..."
}
```
Matt: telemetry: we should record pin-change latency histograms and tag by tenant, route, and pin_intent. that will help SLOs when rolling out canaries. also ensure PII-free tags.
Anita: security concern — telemetry_tags must not leak tenant secrets or freeform emails. enforce regex whitelist in ingestion.
Ryan: action items: 1) schema PR with public/internal split + enums + fingerprint, 2) migration plan + backfill job + verification, 3) client SDK update to respect soft vs hard pins and grace_window_ms.
Liam: i'll draft the PR and include a compatibility shim in the server to read old pins. :thumbsup:
Sara: ETA for the PR?
Liam: aiming for Wed EOD.
Matt: i'll block a migration window next Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC and coordinate with platform on rollback steps.
deploy-bot: heads-up: schema-proxy canary scheduled Tue 10:00 UTC (workers=3) — will run smoke tests after deploy.
Anita: perfect — once PR is up i'll do a review and we can sync on the migration checklist. thanks all.
Ryan: will add telemetry quota/ingest limits to the PR notes so we don't blow out metrics.
Matt: verifying ops playbook and alerting hooks as well.
Anita: closing loop: keep pin_intent semantics tight in docs (hard = immediate evict not allowed, soft = eligible for eviction after grace_window_ms), and call out telemetry_tags policy.
Liam: noted, will add examples + client tests.
infra-bot: linked INF-214 -> DEPLOY-98 for canary coordination.
